title: Quercetin inhibits mitophagy-mediated apoptosis and inflammatory response by targeting the PPARgamma/PGC-1alpha/NF-kappaB axis to improve acute liver failure.
authors: Wu, Huan; Wu, Long; Luo, Li; Wu, Ye-Ting; Zhang, Qing-Xiu; Li, Hai-Yang; Zhang, Bao-Fang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究槲皮素通过PPARgamma/PGC-1alpha/NF-kappaB轴改善急性肝衰竭，虽含分子对接和ChIP，但核心是细胞凋亡与炎症表型，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Reactive oxygen species (ROS) from mitochondrial dysfunction are critical in triggering apoptosis and inflammation in acute liver failure (ALF). Quercetin (QUE), an antioxidant, is renowned for its therapeutic effects onliverdiseases. There are no studies on whether QUE regulates mitophagy level in hepatocytes to inhibit ALF. OBJECTIVE: This study investigates QUE's protective effects on ALF and elucidates the mechanisms involved. METHODS: The ALF and hepatocyte inflammatory injury model was established using LPS and D-Galn. To predict potential targets and mechanisms of QUE in ALF treatment, transcriptomics, network pharmacology, molecular docking techniques, and ChIP were employed. The expression level related to mitophagy, apoptosis, and signaling pathways were detected by CCK8, IHC, IF staining, TUNEL, RT-qPCR, TEM, Western blotting, ELISA, and flow cytometry. RESULTS: Network pharmacology and transcriptomics revealed common targets between QUE and ALF. Enrichment analysis showed that the anti-ALF targets of QUE were significantly associated with mitochondria and NF-kappaB-related pathways. Subsequent experiments showed that QUE pretreatment significantly alleviated the loss of hepatocyte viability, enhanced mitochondrial membrane potential, activated mitophagy, and promoted the clearance of damaged mitochondria, thereby reducing ROS accumulation, significantly reducing cell apoptosis and inflammatory responses, reducing ALT and AST levels, and improving liver tissue pathology. Mechanistically, molecular docking, DARTS, and CETSA analyses confirmed that QUE directly binds to the PPARgamma molecule, which reduced binding to IkappaB and significantly inhibit the NF-kappaB pathway to exert its protective effects. CONCLUSION: In short, our results provide the first evidence that QUE improves acute liver failure by promoting mitophagy through regulating the PPARgamma/PGC-1alpha/NF-kappaB axis and inhibiting apoptosis and inflammatory responses mediated by mitochondrial dysfunction, which provides evidence for the potential of QUE in the treatment of ALF.
abstract_zh: 背景：线粒体功能障碍产生的活性氧（ROS）在急性肝衰竭（ALF）中触发细胞凋亡和炎症反应中至关重要。槲皮素（QUE）作为一种抗氧化剂，以其对肝脏疾病的治疗作用而闻名。目前尚无关于QUE是否通过调节肝细胞线粒体自噬水平来抑制ALF的研究。目的：本研究探讨QUE对ALF的保护作用，并阐明其涉及的机制。方法：使用LPS和D-Galn建立ALF及肝细胞炎症损伤模型。为预测QUE治疗ALF的潜在靶点和机制，采用了转录组学、网络药理学、分子对接技术和ChIP。通过CCK8、IHC、IF染色、TUNEL、RT-qPCR、TEM、Western blotting、ELISA和流式细胞术检测与线粒体自噬、凋亡及信号通路相关的表达水平。结果：网络药理学和转录组学揭示了QUE与ALF之间的共同靶点。富集分析显示，QUE的抗ALF靶点与线粒体和NF-kappaB相关通路显著关联。后续实验表明，QUE预处理显著缓解了肝细胞活力丧失，增强了线粒体膜电位，激活了线粒体自噬，并促进了受损线粒体的清除，从而减少ROS积累，显著降低细胞凋亡和炎症反应，降低ALT和AST水平，并改善肝组织病理。机制上，分子对接、DARTS和CETSA分析确认QUE直接结合PPARgamma分子，这减少了与IkappaB的结合，并显著抑制NF-kappaB通路以发挥其保护作用。结论：总之，我们的结果首次提供证据表明，QUE通过调节PPARgamma/PGC-1alpha/NF-kappaB轴促进线粒体自噬，并抑制由线粒体功能障碍介导的凋亡和炎症反应，从而改善急性肝衰竭，这为QUE在ALF治疗中的潜力提供了证据。
